docs.summary: Scales rectangles of one texture's first mip and layer into rectangles of another's in one command, each destination texel taking its nearest source texel, so depths are never blended. The textures must differ, be of formats [`SupportsBlit`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.GraphicsDevice~SupportsBlit) allows, and be in transfer source and destination states.
